story:
    id: summary-views
    feature: calculator
    title: Read summary views
    as_a: Calculator User
    i_want: a concise summary in each view
    so_that: I can scan a document
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: 001-brief
          description: The viewer must display a summary of at most 150 words when the Calculator User requests the brief view.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a shared document is selected
            - when:
                - the Calculator User requests the "brief" view
            - then:
                - the summary has at most 150 words
        - id: 002-overview
          description: The viewer must display a summary of at most 150 words when the Calculator User requests the overview view.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a shared document is selected
            - when:
                - the Calculator User requests the "overview" view
            - then:
                - the summary has at most 150 words
        - id: 003-preview
          description: The viewer must display a summary of at most 150 words when the Calculator User requests the preview view.
          steps:
            - given:
                - a shared document is selected
            - when:
                - the Calculator User requests the "preview" view
            - then:
                - the summary has at most 150 words
